title: Serenity Homes | Best Home Builder
snippet: Serenity Homes is a local, family business with roots in Iowa. They take pride in our community and the houses we build. Serenity Homes was voted People's Choice Best Home Builder three years in a row. They build homes in Ankeny, Des Moines,West Des Moines, Norwalk, Cumming, Boonville, Grimes, Waukee, Clive, Polk City, Urbandale, Johnston, Van Meter, Altoona, Windsor Heights, Pleasant Hill ...
